items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Al Norris and I, we'd drink anything we could get our hands on.

ctx.x: Yeah, very nice people, out of Warren, Ohio. He had a brother that could drink as much whiskey as Al Norris and I, by the name of Connie Lunsford. He was a valet. Yes, he really could -- I mean he drank -- he drank pretty heavy. Lunsford used to look at him in disgust. He never would say anything to him. Well, he's dead now also. And I'm still alive, thank God. I'll never take a drink of whiskey in my life, the remainder of my life, and I've been off now quite a number of years, and you couldn't pay me to drink…

And I get periodic checkups quite often. My organs are absolutely normal, liver, kidney, heart, no cardiac condition. I'm in good, normal -- I'm in good, normal condition. I'm talking like this -- I want to say it right. Yes, I go right down on the corner there.
